BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Cannon Master Bakuzan!!
Oh, come on! Just shoot it down already!\nExplosives aren't cheap, you know!
Yes sir, but that ark is surprisingly sturdy...
Just make sure you hit it!\nBecause I love the sound of cannonballs exploding
more than I love eating three times a day!\nKaboom!!!
I know! I know, but...
There they are~! They're the bandits, right?
Aye! There's a huge cannon too!
Who the hey are you?
We're related to the thing you're hunting.\nIf you don't stop firing that cannon immediately,\nyou're gonna regret it!
Bwahahaha! Are you kidding me? I'm Bakuzan, the\nCannon Master! How dare you challenge me?\nYou fools don't know who you're messing with!
What? Cannon Master? What's that?
He's not even using the cannon. It's his lackey\nwho's doing the shooting!
Shut up! You don't have to rub it in!
Bwahahaha, imagine what would happen if a cannon\nhit you from this close...?
Kaboom!!! For sure you'll explode and your body\nwill be blown to bits!!
Alright, let's do this!\nBe careful, don't get shot!
Bwahahaha! I'll make sure you get shot!
Oh, no! The cannon is completely shattered!
We've been polishing and taking good care of it\nevery single day. This is unbelievable...
I know it's weird to give advice to bandits, but\nI kinda feel bad for them...
The cannonball doesn't match the size of the\ncannon, you know. That's why it wobbles and misses\nwhen you fire it!
Ah, I see!
It also puts a strain on the barrel, which could\ndamage it. If it explodes, it could lead to a\nhuge accident, you know!
I, I got it!
Don't forget, even the sturdiest wall can crumble\nbecause of a single crack.
A single crack...\nSunset Garocca?!
Who's that?
The legendary hero who taught our kind how to make\nexplosives...Those words are the same as the\nteachings of "Sunset Garocca"!
What? I wonder who that weredragon guy really is!
Welp, since the cannon is gone, the ark should be\nable to land safely, right?
Aye? I don't see the ark though?
What?!
There it is~! How could it get swept off that far?\nWhat's Kunon doing?!
The cannon shots must've broken the steering\nmechanism. It's still moving, so we should be able\nto get it working again once we fix it.
It's not gonna crash into a monsters' den or right\nin the middle of a place full of Coenubias right?
Aye, no problem!
You know what? I don't think there's any Coenubia\nover there.
There you go saying something silly again~!
Well, anyway, let's go check it!\nI see it's starting to become stable. It won't\ncrash.
